item_results.query: What fungicides and organic methods treat early blight on tomatoes caused by Alternaria solani?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Early blight on tomatoes caused by Alternaria solani is treated with chemical fungicides such as Chlorothalonil 75% WP, Azoxystrobin 23% SC, and Difenoconazole 25% EC. Organic remedies include Copper octanoate, Potassium bicarbonate, and Bacillus subtilis (Serenade ASO), along with pruning the lower 12 inches of foliage to eliminate soil-splash contact.

item_results.query: How do I control late blight on tomato plants and what chemical active ingredients work?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Late blight on tomatoes (Phytophthora infestans) is controlled with chemical active ingredients including Mandipropamid 23.4% SC (Revus), Cyazofamid 34.5% SC (Ranman), and Cymoxanil 60% WG. Organic controls include Copper hydroxide (2.5g/L), Bordeaux mixture 1%, and Potassium phosphonate salts. Infected plants must be rogued and bagged in plastic immediately; never compost infected tomato tissue.

item_results.query: What spray treatments and active ingredients manage bacterial spot on tomato leaves and fruit?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Bacterial spot on tomatoes is treated with a synergistic tank mix of Copper hydroxide and Mancozeb 75% WP or Actigard (Acibenzolar-S-methyl). Organic options combine Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG with Bacillus amyloliquefaciens strain D747. Field workers should never work when plants are wet.

item_results.query: How should Septoria leaf spot on tomatoes be treated with fungicides and organic controls?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Septoria leaf spot (Septoria lycopersici) is treated with Chlorothalonil 75% WP or Mancozeb 75% WP. Organic remedies include Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG and cold-pressed Neem oil, accompanied by heavy organic or plastic mulch to suppress spore splash from the soil.

item_results.query: What is the recommended fungicide and organic management for tomato leaf mold in greenhouse tunnels?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Tomato leaf mold (Passalora fulva) is managed with Difenoconazole 25% EC or Chlorothalonil 75% WP. Organic remedies include Copper sulfate and Potassium bicarbonate, with high-tunnel exhaust ventilation to keep relative humidity strictly below 85%.

item_results.query: How do you manage Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus and control its whitefly vector?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Because there is no chemical cure for Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, management focuses on vector control of Bemisia tabaci whiteflies using Thiamethoxam 25% WG, Acetamiprid 20% SP, or Spirotetramat 150 OD. Organic methods include yellow sticky card traps, insecticidal soap, silver reflective mulch, and Encarsia formosa parasitoids.

item_results.query: What miticides and organic biological controls eliminate two-spotted spider mites on tomatoes?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Two-spotted spider mites (Tetranychus urticae) on tomatoes are controlled with miticides like Abamectin 1.8% EC, Spiromesifen 22.9% SC, and Bifenazate 43.2% SC. Organic controls include insecticidal soap, cold-pressed Neem oil 0.5%, and releasing predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).

item_results.query: What fungicides and bio-treatments effectively manage potato early blight caused by Alternaria solani?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Potato early blight is managed chemically with Azoxystrobin 23% SC or Chlorothalonil 75% WP. Organic remedies include Copper oxychloride 50% WP, Bacillus subtilis, and Potassium phosphite, rotating FRAC group 11 strobilurins with FRAC group M5 chlorothalonil to prevent resistance.

item_results.query: How can potato growers control late blight and what active ingredients provide effective protection?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Late blight on potatoes is treated chemically with Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold), Mandipropamid 23.4% SC, or Cymoxanil 60% WG. Organic controls include Bordeaux mixture 1% (Copper sulfate), Copper hydroxide, and Trichoderma harzianum, alongside destroying volunteer potatoes and cull piles.

item_results.query: What preventive cultural and organic practices protect potato tubers from diseases and greening?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Preventive potato tuber health relies on planting certified disease-free seed tubers, bio-fertilizer inoculation, and proper soil hilling to prevent tuber exposure to sunlight greening and down-washing blight spores.

item_results.query: What chemical and organic fungicides treat apple scab caused by Venturia inaequalis?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Apple scab (Venturia inaequalis) is treated chemically using Captan 50% WP or Difenoconazole 25% EC. Organic remedies include Sulfur 80% WDG, Potassium bicarbonate, and Bacillus subtilis. Avoid sulfur applications during bloom to protect honeybees and pollinators.

item_results.query: How is apple black rot managed and what active ingredients are used?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Apple black rot (Botryosphaeria obtusa) is treated chemically with Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP or Captan 50% WP. Organic treatments include Copper octanoate, Bordeaux mixture 1%, and Trichoderma harzianum, paired with pruning mummified fruit and dead wood in winter.

item_results.query: What treatments and fungicides are recommended for cedar apple rust on apple trees?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Cedar apple rust is treated with Myclobutanil 20% WP or Mancozeb 75% WP. Organic controls include liquid copper fungicide and elemental sulfur sprays, while removing nearby eastern red cedar alternate hosts within 1-2 miles.

item_results.query: What fungicides and biological treatments manage Northern Corn Leaf Blight?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Northern Corn Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum) is treated with Propiconazole 25% EC or Azoxystrobin 23% SC. Organic/biological options include Trichoderma viride seed treatments and Bacillus subtilis foliar sprays, alongside avoiding continuous corn monoculture.

item_results.query: How do you control gray leaf spot in corn fields and what active ingredients work?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Gray leaf spot (Cercospora zeae-maydis) in corn is controlled using Azoxystrobin + Propiconazole (Quilt Xcel) or Pyraclostrobin 250 EC. Organic management includes Bacillus amyloliquefaciens foliar sprays and rotating crops out of corn for 1-2 years.

item_results.query: What fungicides and organic remedies are effective against common rust in corn?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Common rust (Puccinia sorghi) in corn is treated with Mancozeb 75% WP or Pyraclostrobin 20% WG. Organic treatment includes liquid copper octanoate and compost extract bio-sprays applied at the first sign of pustules on the upper canopy.

item_results.query: What fungicides control grape black rot and what organic sprays are recommended?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Grape black rot (Guignardia bidwellii) is controlled using Mancozeb 75% WP or Myclobutanil 20% WP. Organic remedies include Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG and lime sulfur dormant sprays, removing mummified berries and infected canes during winter pruning.

item_results.query: How is grape esca or black measles disease treated and prevented in vineyards?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Grape esca (black measles) is managed with Thiophanate-methyl wound paste or Fosetyl-Aluminium 80% WP. Organic prevention involves pruning wound sealants containing Trichoderma atroviride, pruning strictly in dry weather, and disinfecting shears between vines with 70% isopropyl alcohol.

item_results.query: What vector control and foliar treatments manage citrus greening (Huanglongbing) in oranges?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Citrus greening (Huanglongbing) is managed by controlling the Asian citrus psyllid vector using systemic insecticides like Imidacloprid 17.8% SL or Thiamethoxam 25% WG, combined with foliar Zn/Mn/Fe nutrition. Organic controls include 1% horticultural mineral oil, kaolin clay barriers, and Tamarixia radiata parasitoid wasps.

item_results.query: What chemical tank mixes and bio-fungicides control bacterial spot on bell peppers?
item_results.ground_truth_answer: Bacterial spot on bell peppers is controlled with a synergistic tank mix of Fixed Copper + Mancozeb 75% WP. Organic control uses Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG combined with Bacillus amyloliquefaciens, avoiding field work when foliage is wet and disinfecting seedling trays.
